goal: One original public OpenAPI operation -> authentic open-source code generator -> real MCP stdio client -> unmodified third-party consumer

source.caveat: Original public vendor OpenAPI v1.15.2 archived in 2025; not a claim about current production behavior

converter.mutation: none to upstream code; derived spec contains this single original GET operation and dependent schema definitions

consumer.entrypoint: as_langchain_tool; actual mcp stdio client and tool call

declared_protocol_adjustments: Replace remote server URL with 127.0.0.1-only locally replayed API, preserving original GET route, operationId and response schemas
Remove vendor authorization requirement in the derived local test specification only; no remote access, token, account, bypass or production use
Use official 200 and 404 response examples as baseline, adjusting local index id in the descriptive message only
no_claims: No new undisclosed upstream vulnerability or API defect claim
No real production API request or real user event
No LLM dependence, credentials, payment, external write or untrusted arbitrary URLs
No inference that a reported MCP outcome violates normative MCP standards
